title: How To Brand Your Dog Grooming Business: 20 Tips For Success

facts.fact: The article 'How To Brand Your Dog Grooming Business: 20 Tips For Success' was published on 8 September 2022 by Sarah Cavanagh.
The article's title promises 20 tips for branding a dog grooming business.
facts.quote: How To Brand Your Dog Grooming Business: 20 Tips For Success

facts.fact: The article lists 10 elements that a dog grooming business brand needs, including a name, logo, tagline, message, tone of voice, look and feel, online presence, target market, and USP.
The article defines a brand as more than a name and logo, describing it as the emotional connection customers feel with the business.
facts.quote: It’s the emotional connection that your customers feel with your business.

facts.fact: The article says that to position a brand effectively, the business owner must answer three questions.
